source_caption_text:
The eye contact after the question 😭

E-40’s “Uh Huh” featuring YV is one of those Bay Area tracks that gets stuck in your head fast. Released in 2016 on The D-Boy Diary: Book 2, the song has that simple, heavy beat that leaves plenty of room for E-40 to do what he does best.

YV handles the hook while E-40 fills the verses with his usual slang and quick delivery. The back-and-forth works really well, especially with the “penny, nickel, and dimin’” to “hundreds, fifties, and thousands” part of the hook.

The music video keeps things pretty straightforward, with E-40 and YV taking the song around the Bay and letting the track do most of the work. It’s a good example of E-40 staying true to his sound while working with a younger artist from the same area.

#e40 #rap #meme
